segments.title: Apple's new hub knows your face
segments.say: Apple's new HomeView went on sale November thirteenth. It knows your face.

segments.title: Up to six faces
segments.say: It can recognize up to six people, and keeps each person's stuff separate.

segments.title: Your texts need your iPhone
segments.say: Your Messages and Calendar only show when it sees you, and your iPhone is nearby and recently unlocked.

segments.title: Camera data walled off
segments.say: Apple says camera and mic data is processed in Secure Exclaves, which even Apple can't access.

segments.title: Not sold in the EU
segments.say: Not sold in the EU, and Siri AI on it is still in beta.
